descriptionChirho: The visible sky or the celestial realm above the earth; Hebrew שָׁמַיִם (shamayim) is inherently dual/plural in form. The two clusters differ only in grammatical state: S141879 includes construct (שְׁמֵי, 'heavens of') and absolute forms with prepositions, while S141880 shows absolute plural. All translations converge on a single referent: eng 'heavens/the-heavens', spa 'cielo/cielos', hin आकाश, arb السَّمَاء/السَّمَاوَات, kor 하늘, swa mbingu. No semantic distinction warrants separate senses; the split is purely morphosyntactic (construct vs. absolute, with/without article).
